description: Use complete, fresh registry snapshots to age exact third-party container digests.

transformTemplates: ($age := $toMillis($now()) - $toMillis(collectedAt); schemaVersion = 1 and packageName = "{{packageName}}" and $age >= 0 and $age <= 21600000 ? {"releases": releases} : $error("Missing, stale, or mismatched container publication snapshot"))

($key := function($v) { ($parts := $split($replace($v, /^v/, ""), "-"); $match := $match($parts[0], /^(\d+(?:\.\d+)*)(\w*)$/); $exists($match) ? $string([$map($split($match.groups[0], "."), function($part) { $number($part) }), $match.groups[1], $join($append([], $parts[[1..$count($parts)]]), "-")]) : $v) }; $groups := releases{$key(version): $}; {"releases": [$map(releases, function($row) { ($rows := $append([], $lookup($groups, $key($row.version))); $timestamp := $count($rows.releaseTimestamp) = $count($rows) ? $fromMillis($max($map($rows.releaseTimestamp, function($timestamp) { $toMillis($timestamp) }))); $merge([$sift($row, function($value, $name) { $name != "releaseTimestamp" }), {"releaseTimestamp": $timestamp}])) })]})

packageRules.description: Keep registry names and digest pinning for Docker versions and the supported nonroot alias; require fresh publication evidence.
matchJsonata: (currentValue != "nonroot" or packageName in ["gcr.io/distroless/static", "gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12"]) and ($not($contains(currentValue, /^[a-f0-9]{7,40}$/)) or $contains(currentValue, /^[0-9]+$/)) and ($registry := "https://" & $substringBefore(packageName, "/"); ($not($exists(registryUrls)) or registryUrls = null or $count(registryUrls) = 0 or ($count(registryUrls) = 1 and (registryUrls[0] = $registry or registryUrls[0] = $registry & "/"))) and ($not($exists(defaultRegistryUrls)) or defaultRegistryUrls = null or $count(defaultRegistryUrls) = 0) and ($not($exists(additionalRegistryUrls)) or additionalRegistryUrls = null or $count(additionalRegistryUrls) = 0))
